home.second_section_first_text: O Pioneiro do Mondego is a family-run adventure sports and ecotourism company based in the municipality of Penacova. Our principal activity is organising river descents by kayak and canoe on the Mondego River, between Penacova and Coimbra — a scenic canoe trip through the Mondego valley, operated daily since 1988. O Pioneiro was founded in 1988 by two Belgian teachers, Dirk and Kristien, and was one of the first adventure-tourism companies in Portugal and the country’s first canoeing operator. Over the years the company has grown and more than 100,000 people from around the world have made the Mondego descent with us. Today the Pioneiro do Mondego descent is a nationally and internationally recognised attraction, named by the American guide Rough Guides as a reference for tourism in Coimbra alongside the University and listed among the top 15 places to visit in Portugal.
home.second_section_second_text: The most popular and spectacular route in Portugal. We run daily descents of 18 or 25 km. Easy, incredible views and well-maintained equipment.
home.third_section_bannerTwo_title:
All that at an affordable price
Book now!
home.third_section_cardOne_text: Our popularity has drawn competitors, but as pioneers with nearly 30 years of experience we offer unique advantages. Our team of young local guides are experienced, know the river intimately and speak several languages.
home.third_section_cardTwo_text: Not only are we the only company that runs the descent every day, we also have the largest fleet of canoes on the river, enabling us to accept any number of participants, from single bookings to groups of hundreds.
home.third_section_cardThree_text: Finally, our monitoring and safety system prioritises the freedom of our customers; everyone can make the descent at their own pace without being obliged to stay with a group tour.
